summary: Global Ship Lease filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing the exercise of options for two additional mid-size, ultra-high-reefer, wide-beam newbuild containerships for aggregate contract price of approximately $163 million, with deliveries scheduled in 4Q29. The transaction is an ordinary fleet capital-expenditure and newbuilding-order action, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or go-private. The company is in discussions with prospective charterers; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated.
